origin.description: Pipe an object into a function or call and store the result back in that object.

arguments.name: lhs
arguments.text: The starting value and the place the result is written.

arguments.name: rhs
arguments.text: A function or a call, using the same rules as %>%.

origin.details: The assignment pipe must come first in a chain. some_object %<>% foo %>% bar is some_object <- some_object %>% foo %>% bar. Later steps follow the ordinary pipe, including lazy evaluation.

translation.description: Pipe a value and, when given a dict and a name, store the result under that name.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: The starting value. When this is a dict and the next argument is a string, that string is a name in the dict rather than a step.

arguments.name: name
arguments.text: Key to read and then overwrite. Used only in the dict form.

arguments.name: steps
arguments.text: The same callable and (function, args, kwargs) steps as pipe.

translation.details: compound(value, *steps) returns the lazy pipe of that value. compound(namespace, name, *steps) pipes namespace[name], writes the result back, and returns it.
